answer: Sponsors are capped at 6 vouches per epoch, so one rich backer cannot mint an army of aliases. Each vouch locks 33 POA until the newcomer survives 9 clean epochs, and a farm of 140 fakes must find 140 separate sponsors willing to risk real money on strangers. Without quartz the panel is blind, without shale the farm is free, and without quill nobody can prove what happened.
